lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਾ ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: pooraa bhaag hovai mukh masatak sadaa har ke gun gaahi ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Perfect destiny is inscribed upon your forehead and face; sing the Praises of the Lord forever. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam bhojan har dei ||
lines.translation: The Lord bestows the Ambrosial Food of the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਲੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot madhe koee viralaa lei ||
lines.translation: Out of millions, only a rare few receive it

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਅਪਣੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jis no apanee nadar karei ||1||
lines.translation: - only those who are blessed by God's Glance of Grace. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur ke charan man maahi vasaai ||
lines.translation: Whoever enshrines the Guru's Feet within his mind,

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਅਨੑੇਰਾ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh anheraa a(n)darahu jaai ||
lines.translation: is rid of pain and darkness from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aape saachaa lae milaai ||2||
lines.translation: The True Lord unites him with Himself. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee baanee siu laai piaar ||
lines.translation: So embrace love for the Word of the Guru's Bani.

lines.gurmukhi: ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਏਹੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aithai othai ehu adhaar ||
lines.translation: Here and hereafter, this is your only Support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵੈ ਸਿਰਜਨਹਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aape devai sirajanahaar ||3||
lines.translation: The Creator Lord Himself bestows it. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਮਨਾਏ ਅਪਣਾ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa manaae apanaa bhaanaa ||
lines.translation: One whom the Lord inspires to accept His Will,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਈ ਭਗਤੁ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੋੁਜਾਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: soee bhagat sughaR soujaanaa ||
lines.translation: is a wise and knowing devotee.

lines.transliteration: naanak tis kai sad kurabaanaa ||4||7||17||7||24||
lines.translation: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to him. ||4||7||17||7||24||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਬਿਭਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 4 bibhaas ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehl, Bibhaas:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਉਨਮਨਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: rasak rasak gun gaavah guramat liv unaman naam lagaan ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord with joyous love and delight; I am enraptured, lovingly attuned to the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਮ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit ras peeaa gurasabadee ham naam vitahu kurabaan ||1||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I drink in the Ambrosial Essence; I am a sacrifice to the Naam. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: hamare jagajeevan har praan ||
lines.translation: The Lord, the Life of the World, is my Breath of Life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਭਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤੁ ਦੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ootam rid a(n)tar bhaaio gur ma(n)t deeo har kaan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Lofty and Exalted Lord became pleasing to my heart and my inner being, when the Guru breathed the Mantra of the Lord into my ears. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavahu sa(n)t milahu mere bhaaee mil har har naam vakhaan ||
lines.translation: Come, O Saints: let us join together, O Siblings of Destiny; let us meet and chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਰਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਨ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kit bidh kiu paaeeai prabh apunaa mo kau karahu upades har daan ||2||
lines.translation: How am I to find my God? Please bless me with the Gift of the Lord's Teachings. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਜਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: satasa(n)gat mahi har har vasiaa mil sa(n)gat har gun jaan ||
lines.translation: The Lord, Har, Har, abides in the Society of the Saints; joining this Sangat, the Lord's Glories are known.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਰਸਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag satasa(n)gat paaee gur satigur paras bhagavaan ||3||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, the Society of the Saints is found. Through the Guru, the True Guru, I receive the Touch of the Lord God. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ਰਹੇ ਹੈਰਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaavah prabh agam thaakur ke gun gaai rahe hairaan ||
lines.translation: I sing the Glorious Praises of God, my Inaccessible Lord and Master; singing His Praises, I am enraptured.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਓ ਖਿਨ ਦਾਨ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kau gur kirapaa dhaaree har naam deeo khin daan ||4||1||
lines.translation: The Guru has showered His Mercy on servant Nanak; in an instant, He blessed him with the Gift of the Lord's Name. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਗਵੈ ਸੂਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਸਭ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਮੑਾਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: ugavai soor guramukh har bolahi sabh rain samhaalahi har gaal ||
lines.translation: With the rising of the sun, the Gurmukh speaks of the Lord. All through the night, he dwells upon the Sermon of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਹਮ ਲੋਚ ਲਗਾਈ ਹਮ ਕਰਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਲ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hamarai prabh ham loch lagaaee ham karah prabhoo har bhaal ||1||
lines.translation: My God has infused this longing within me; I seek my Lord God. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਧੂਰਿ ਰਵਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa man saadhoo dhoor ravaal ||
lines.translation: My mind is the dust of the feet of the Holy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਗੁਰ ਪਗ ਝਾਰਹ ਹਮ ਬਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam driRaaio gur meethaa gur pag jhaarah ham baal ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Guru has implanted the Sweet Name of the Lord, Har, Har, within me. I dust the Guru's Feet with my hair. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਕਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਅੰਧਾਰੀ ਮੋਹਿ ਫਾਥੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: saakat kau din rain a(n)dhaaree mohi phaathe maaiaa jaal ||
lines.translation: Dark are the days and nights of the faithless cynics; they are caught in the trap of attachment to Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਵਸਿਓ ਰਿਨਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਾਲ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: khin pal har prabh ridai na vasio rin baadhe bahu bidh baal ||2||
lines.translation: The Lord God does not dwell in their hearts, even for an instant; every hair of their heads is totally tied up in debts. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਤਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਹਉ ਛੂਟੇ ਮਮਤਾ ਜਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: satasa(n)gat mil mat budh paaee hau chhoote mamataa jaal ||
lines.translation: Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, wisdom and understanding are obtained, and one is released from the traps of egotism and possessiveness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠ ਲਗਾਨਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har naamaa har meeth lagaanaa gur keee sabad nihaal ||3||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name, and the Lord, seem sweet to me. Through the Word of His Shabad, the Guru has made me happy. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਗੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham baarik gur agam gusaaee gur kar kirapaa pratipaal ||
lines.translation: I am just a child; the Guru is the Unfathomable Lord of the World. In His Mercy, He cherishes and sustains me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਭਉਜਲ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bikh bhaujal dubade kaadh lehu prabh gur naanak baal gupaal ||4||2||
lines.translation: I am drowning in the ocean of poison; O God, Guru, Lord of the World, please save Your child, Nanak. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭਾਤੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabhaatee mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Prabhaatee, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਰਸਕ ਰਸੀਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik khin har prabh kirapaa dhaaree gun gaae rasak raseek ||
lines.translation: The Lord God showered me with His Mercy for an instant; I sing His Glorious Praises with joyous love and delight.
